actions.name: System Vulnerability Assessment
actions.description: System vulnerability assessment relates all the vulnerabilities of a system's components in the context of their configuration and internal dependencies and can also include assessing risk emerging from the system's design as a whole, not just the sum of individual component vulnerabilities.

actions.name: Operational Process Monitoring
actions.description: Monitoring physical parameters and operator actions related to an operational environment.

actions.name: Operational Logic Validation
actions.description: Validation of variable state in the context of the control logic of the operational application.

subgoals.embedding_context: Authorize connections and information exchange between systems using interconnection agreements

actions.name: Network Access Mediation
actions.description: Network access mediation is the control method for authorizing access to a system by a user (or a process acting on behalf of a user) communicating through a network, including a local area network, a wide area network, and the Internet.

actions.name: Routing Access Mediation
actions.description: Routing access mediation is a network security approach that manages and controls access at the network layer using VPNs, tunneling protocols, firewall rules, and traffic inspection to ensure secure and efficient data routing.

actions.name: Access Modeling
actions.description: Access modeling captures and records the access permissions granted to identities (e.g., administrators, users, groups, systems) and optionally includes details on how these identities are stored, managed, and shared across systems.

actions.name: Prevent Manipulation
actions.description: Secure hardware interfaces by using strong authentication methods, encryption, and interface-specific security protocols to prevent unauthorized manipulation and ensure control over AI hardware systems.

actions.name: End-to-end encryption
actions.description: Implement end-to-end encryption (e.g., TLS, HTTPS) to protect the integrity and confidentiality of communications between AI systems.

actions.name: Secure communication channels
actions.description: Communication channels between the model and the interface responsible for displaying the results should be secured using secure protocols such as SSL/TLS.
